zh-Hans: 现在先忍着跟紧，得找个机会才行。
en: I'll stay with him for now. I've got to find an opening.

zh-Hans: 老哥，这家伙真难缠啊。该怎么办？
en: He's tough, bro. What do I do?

zh-Hans: 难受的肯定不止我一个。就比谁更能撑！
en: I'm not the only one struggling. Let's see who can hold out longer!

zh-Hans: 怎么回事，偏偏今天 FD 感觉这么迟钝！
en: What's wrong? Why does my FD feel so sluggish today?

zh-Hans: 这家伙不知道前面是什么路吗？不减速入弯，可要一头栽进谷底啊！
en: Doesn't he know what's ahead? If he doesn't slow for the corner, he's going straight into the ravine!
What?! An inertia drift?!

zh-Hans: 能行，我有感觉！我的 FD 正在告诉我，一定能行！
en: I can do this! I can feel it! My FD is telling me I can!
What?!
No way... That can't be...
What?
He's caught me!
What the hell!
Tch!
How could I...?
Damn it!
I blew it!
This is bad!
What?!

zh-Hans: 那混蛋，脑袋里准是少了两三根筋！
en: That bastard's got more than a few screws loose!
You've got to be kidding! Damn it!

zh-Hans: 我可是赤城 RedSuns 的二号车手啊！
en: I'm the number two driver in the Akagi RedSuns!

zh-Hans: 可恶，难道第二颗涡轮停了？！
en: Damn it! Has my secondary turbo stopped working?!

zh-Hans: 饶了我吧，这简直是疯了！
en: Give me a break. This is madness!

zh-Hans: 开始让人害怕了。他到底还要加速到什么时候？
en: This is getting scary. How long is he going to keep accelerating?
Can't I win this battle?!

zh-Hans: 正合我意！过两个弯，就让你从后视镜里消失！
en: Fine by me! Two corners, and you'll be gone from my mirror!

zh-Hans: 一直带着他跑，可不妙啊。
en: I can't keep towing him along forever.

zh-Hans: 接下来可要冲进危险地带了！
en: Now we're heading into the danger zone!
Let's see how long you can keep up!
The gap's closing!
His car's getting closer!

zh-Hans: 直道上明明是我更快，还是被咬住了。难道我输在过弯上？！
en: I'm faster on the straights, but he's still on me. Does that mean he's beating me in the corners?!

zh-Hans: 那种凌厉的出弯，看着就让人头疼！
en: The way he shoots out of corners is sickening!
Now then, what's my move?

zh-Hans: 可恶，想给我施压是吧？我才不上当！
en: Damn, trying to pressure me? I'm not falling for it!

zh-Hans: 我可不客气了！你不会再出现在我的后视镜里！
en: No more holding back! You won't show up in my mirror again!
Yes! I'm through!

zh-Hans: 我不过是稍微认真了一点。
en: I just got a little serious, that's all.
The tires have still got grip!
Not good enough!
All right!
Got you!
I can do this!
Don't disappoint me! Keep up!

zh-Hans: 也许你不愿相信，可不接受现实就没法进步！
en: You might not want to believe it, but you won't improve until you face reality!

zh-Hans: 我可不想跟抱着这种半吊子心态的家伙比赛！
en: I don't want to race someone whose heart isn't in it!

zh-Hans: 肾上腺素全开，最大增压，一口气甩掉你！
en: Adrenaline pumping, boost at maximum! I'll blow you away!
I'll make short work of you!

zh-Hans: 我又不是老哥，没法看得那么细，不过这家伙确实很有本事！
en: I'm not my brother, so I can't read all the details. But this guy's definitely good!
I'm not holding anything back!
